messages:
DeployBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary deploy failing for model 'redwood-open-3b-v2' - elevated tokenization errors and incoherent outputs. Auto-pager triggered (sev=P1)
alice_ops: Paging @ben_oncall — can you take this? Canary error-rate spiked to ~18% on a subset of traffic
ben_oncall: On call, looking. Grabbing canary logs + manifest.
clara_sre: I see repeated tokenization exceptions in the inference logs: "unknown token id 50213" and mismatched kv cache errors in some shards
ben_oncall: Initial artifact diff shows model tag published with mismatched tokenizer metadata vs weights. Suspect publish pipeline wrote wrong tokenizer reference.
alice_ops: Kicking quick mitigation: will attempt rollback of canary to previous stable tag. @clara_sre please watch gateway + edges
ben_oncall: Rolling back canary -> executing:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service inference-canary --model-tag r3b-stable-202602
```
ben_oncall: Rollback command submitted, monitoring traffic switch.
DeployBot: Deploy job 98342: rollback started by ben_oncall
alice_ops: Dashboards live: error-rate panel & tokenizer-exception counts up
ellie_support: Notifying affected customers now (CUST-234, CUST-517). Copying status in CS playbook.
frank_custsuccess: Customers reporting garbled outputs and truncated responses. They're asking for ETA on mitigation.
dan_product: Any initial RCA? Config drift, CI bug, or artifact mis-tag?
clara_sre: Quick glance at artifact manifests — tokenizer_version:"v3.1" listed but weight bundle built for tokenizer v3.0. Hashes don't match. Looks like publish job used latest tokenizer ref without locking weightset.
ben_oncall: Rollback progressing — traffic re-routed to r3b-stable-202602. Seeing error-rate drop in first 90s.
DeployBot: Deploy job 98342: rollback completed
ben_oncall: Confirmed: canary error-rate from 18% -> 0.8% within ~3m. Latency back to baseline.
alice_ops: Flipped feature flag 'use-new-model-3b' -> false (audit id ff-7423). Command applied:
`ffctl set use-new-model-3b false --env prod --by alice_ops --reason "tokenizer+weights mismatch"`
ellie_support: Sent follow-up to impacted customers: rollback performed, mitigated for now, postmortem and remediation plan forthcoming. :white_check_mark:
frank_custsuccess: Customers acknowledged and paused integrations for the moment. No escalation to legal.
ben_oncall: Opening incident ticket INC-7423, assigning postmortem owners: @clara_sre (infra artifact investigation) and @dan_product (release gating)
clara_sre: I'll collect publish job logs, artifact manifests, and canary vs stable diffs. Suggest immediate short-term fix: enforce tokenizer hash sanity-check in publish pipeline.
dan_product: Agree. Longer-term: add pre-release invariant checks that validate tokenizer/weight compatibility and block feature flag flips until verified.
alice_ops: Handoff to night ops: summary — rollback completed, customers notified, postmortem owners assigned, FF toggled off, monitor for re-occurrence.
alice_ops: Handoff -> @greg_nightshift (EOD oncall). Please monitor the regression dashboards for 2 hours.
greg_nightshift: Acknowledge. I'll watch SLOs and escalate if we see >2% tokenizer exceptions.
ben_oncall: Adding timeline and evidence to INC-7423. Temporary mitigation steps: 1) rollback, 2) FF flip, 3) customer comms.
DeployBot: Incident severity lowered to P2 — active rollback mitigated symptoms. Re-activate pager if issues reappear.
ellie_support: Logged customer impact in INC-7423: 2 customers affected, garbled output observed, ~10 min window between deploy and rollback, mitigation by rollback and FF disable.
clara_sre: Attaching short repro script to ticket that runs tokenizer/weight manifest compatibility check. Recommend CI gate and a checksum compare in publish step.
dan_product: Scheduling a retro + action items review Wed 09:00 UTC. Owners: @clara_sre (pipeline fix), @alice_ops (FF policy), @dan_product (release gating).
ben_oncall: Final health check: error-rate at 0.5%, latencies normal. Closing active pager and handing off to night shift. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
greg_nightshift: Monitoring overnight. Will pick up postmortem notes tomorrow. Thanks team.
